name: Shehariah
overview: Shehariah was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified uniquely as the son of Jeremoth. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture does not provide additional information or notable events concerning his life or character.
namesAndTitles: The name Shehariah means "he seeks YHWH," reflecting a theologically rich meaning consistent with a God-seeking heart. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:26 and was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Shehariah is explicitly recorded as the son of Jeremoth, establishing a clear paternal relationship within the tribe of Benjamin. No further family connections are documented in Scripture beyond this.
scriptureSignificance: Shehariah's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Benjamin, as noted in 1 Chronicles 8:26. His mention contributes to the biblical record of Israelite lineage, underscoring the importance of preserving the heritage of God's people. While no direct narrative role is attributed to him, his inclusion affirms the faithfulness of God's covenant line through Benjamin.
